abort.not_iseo_device: This device does not appear to be an ISEO lock.

error.auth_failed: The lock rejected the request. Make sure the Argo app is closed, then try again — scan a valid Master Card on the lock (the LED will blink green on success).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock. Check it is powered on and within Bluetooth range.

bluetooth_confirm.description:
Found a new ISEO lock nearby: **{name}**.

Click **Submit** to begin setup.
bluetooth_confirm.title: ISEO lock discovered

data_description.enable_admin: Also enrol an administrator identity, so Home Assistant can list the users on the lock and switch them on and off. It has to be enrolled now, during the same Master Card scan; turning it on later means setting the lock up again.

gw_register.description:
To register Home Assistant as a Gateway:

**Warning:** Close the ARGO app before clicking Submit.

1. Click **Submit** below.
2. **Within 30 seconds**, scan your physical **Master Card** on the lock.

The lock will blink green once the card is read successfully.
gw_register.title: Register gateway

data_description.address: Select the ISEO lock to set up.

user.description: Select your lock from the list of nearby ISEO locks, sorted by signal strength. If your lock is not listed, make sure it is powered on and within Bluetooth range, then click Submit to scan again.

admin_rejected_identity.message: The lock rejected the Home Assistant administrator identity. Set the integration up again to enrol it anew.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the lock.

device_not_found.message: Could not find ISEO lock {address}. Make sure it is powered on and within Bluetooth range.

lock_not_supported.message: Manual locking is not supported by this device. The lock will automatically re-latch after being opened.

lock_rejected_identity.message: Lock rejected the identity. Ensure the UUID is registered in the Argo app.
